text-message.label: Text message
text-message.guidance: Natural lowercase may fit the author's habits; do not assume intimacy.

chat.label: Chat
chat.guidance: Be conversational at the reader's level of familiarity.

email.label: Email
email.guidance: Make the point easy to find; keep the author's warmth and rhythm.

linkedin.label: LinkedIn
linkedin.guidance: Use public professional prose with the author's character intact.

cover-letter.label: Cover letter
cover-letter.guidance: Write specific, professional prose without flattening the author's voice.

essay.label: Essay
essay.guidance: Keep the argument's movement and the author's distinctive devices.

web-copy.label: Web copy
web-copy.guidance: Help readers scan and act; retain concrete language and character.

general.label: General
general.guidance: Keep the source's register; assume no extra familiarity.
